et habitantibus Hierusalem in ablutionem: and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: for the washing of the sinner

dicit Dominus exercituum: Disperdam nomi: saith the Lord of hosts, that I will destroy the names of idols out of the earth
et non memorabuntur ultra et prophetas e: and they shall be remembered no more: and I will take away the false prophets, and the unclean spirit out of the earth
Et erit cum prophetaverit: And it shall come to pass, that when … shall prophesy
ultra dicent ei pater eius et mater eius: any more, his father and his mother that brought him into the world, shall say to him

nec operientur pallio saccino ut mentian: neither shall they be clad with a garment of sackcloth, to deceive
But he shall say: I am no prophet
Homo agricola ego sum, quoniam Adam: I am a husbandman: for Adam
is my example from my youth

et dicet: His plagatus sum: And he shall say: With these I was wounded
and against the man that cleaveth to me

disperdentur et deficient: shall be scattered, and shall perish
but the third part shall be left therein

Et ducam tertiam partem per ignem: And I will bring the third part through the fire
et uram eos sicut uritur argentum et pro: and will refine them as silver is refined: and I will try them as gold is tried

et mulieres violabuntur. Et egredietur m: and the women shall be defiled: and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the rest of the people

as when he fought in the day of battle

qui est contra Hierusalem ad orientem,: which is over against Jerusalem toward the east

medium earum ad mare orientale: half of them to the east sea

they shall be in summer and in winter

IN DIE ILLA ERIT DOMINUS UNUS: in that day there shall be one Lord

et muli et cameli et asini et omnium ium: and of the mule, and of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts, that shall be in those tents

contra Hierusalem, ascendent ab anno in: against Jerusalem, shall go up from year to year
